decisions.reason: Because it is a direct extension of the firm's core spraying competence and has passed its first market test, management would keep it unless niche demand remains clearly below aspiration levels.

As a multi-model product line in the firm's core material-handling business, it likely benefits from strong fit, committed resources, and enough scope for adaptation to customer needs to justify keeping it.

It supports the firm's push toward more future-oriented system solutions, but as a more adjacent offer than the core equipment lines it still faces a comparatively higher withdrawal risk if market acceptance lags aspirations.

Since it is close to the established two-component spraying business and still in the early learning phase, management would likely retain it for another year while monitoring whether results justify the resources committed.
